vulnerability_title: Attacker can create and activate malicious staking proxies

snippets.reason: GitHub URL includes explicit vulnerable line references

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: initialize stores livenessPeriod, stakingManager and activityChecker with only zero-value and contract-code checks, and the file shows how these values control rewards in _calculateStakingRewards and _checkRatioPass and who may call stake. The path that lets an attacker create and activate such a proxy is in StakingFactory and LzOracle, which are other files.
patterns_found: staking parameters accepted without upper bound or allow-list
reward calculation controlled by unchecked parameters
issues: Creation (StakingFactory.createStakingInstance) and activation (LzOracle.lzCreateAndActivateStakingModel) of the malicious proxy are in other contracts; this file shows only the unchecked parameters and their effect.
`initPayload` is a parameter of StakingFactory and does not occur in this file.
